title: Publish v0.1.1 pre-release

context.summary: Tag the current green master and publish v0.1.1 as a public pre-release.
context.background: v0.1.1 must be a new immutable pre-release while v0.1.0 remains historical.

in: Create tag v0.1.1 from the current green master.
Trigger and verify the release workflow.
Verify GHCR image tags, signed release assets, checksums, manifest public key and release notes.

acceptance_criteria: Tag v0.1.1 exists on the intended master commit.
GitHub release v0.1.1 is public and marked as a pre-release.
Signed manifest, public key, checksum, bundle and release notes assets are attached.
GHCR version and commit image tags are visible.
definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
